headline: Deadlocked gains US and PAL matches across menus, networking and engine code
summary: Contributors landed matching work across game code, networking, menus and libraries. US SCUS_974.65 finishes at 4,151 of 18,085 functions and 5.57% matched code by size; PAL SCES_532.85 finishes at 4,553 of 18,113 functions. Matching means the reconstructed C compiles to exactly the original game's bytes.
highlights: #45 contributes 450 PAL reconstructions in batches; its stated 1,000-function target still has 550 outstanding. #43 adds 57 PAL functions, including resident and multiplayer menus.
#46 covers 276 functions across game, network and engine code; #47 adds 56 engine/library functions, also matching 53 PAL functions.
Duplicate PAL copies were removed where shared C already matched, resolving object-name collisions and false relocation-audit mismatches.
#41 matches console read/write wrappers on both US and PAL. The Tempus Station function in #48 and assembler changes with 27 PAL functions in #49 remain unmerged; #44 closed as a draft.
